title: trifolium pratense var. baeticum
intro: Trifolium pratense var. baeticum, commonly known as the white clover, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the legume family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help manage stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of T. pratense var. baeticum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anxiolytic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins.
